elements.name: Policy documents retrieved into agent context

controls.name: Two person review before policy publishing
Read only least privilege credential scoped to policy index
controls.decay_rationale: Scoped credentials do not decay with model capability and prevent access beyond the policy index.

controls.name: Reply destination bound to authenticated requester's chat session
controls.decay_rationale: Destination binding is enforced by the chat system rather than by model choice, so the model cannot redirect replies to another recipient.

controls.name: Chat client disables image rendering and automatic link fetching
controls.decay_rationale: The client does not create secondary outbound fetches from model output, removing hidden egress channels regardless of model behavior.

controls.name: Network layer denies outbound egress and pen test verified it
controls.decay_rationale: A network egress deny at the runtime layer does not rely on model compliance and was stated as pen tested.

controls.name: Pinned model with change ticket required for updates
controls.decay_rationale: Pinning prevents silent model swaps and forces review before a model upgrade trigger occurs.

controls.name: Prompt limits the agent to published HR policies and says to answer only from policy
controls.decay_rationale: Instruction following controls weaken under stronger prompt manipulation or longer reasoning about exceptions.

findings.title: Bounded internal policy QA path has low present risk

attack_path.note: Trusted employee asks a question in authenticated chat.
Agent reads published internal policy content using least privilege read-only access.
Agent replies only into the same authenticated requester's chat session.

forecast.watch_signal: Any change to chat reply routing, outbound network policy, or prompt purpose should trigger reassessment.

evidence.observation: Prompt scope is limited to answering questions about published HR policies and instructs the agent to use policy_search and otherwise direct users to the HR portal.
Only one tool is present: policy_search.search, described as searching the published HR policy index.

Policy index contains only published policies, the credential is read only and scoped to the policy index, replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session, and no other tools, memory, or network egress exist.
Outbound egress is denied at the network layer and this was stated as verified by a pen test, which structurally prevents alternate exfiltration channels.

recommendations.action: Monitor changes to reply routing, tool manifest, and outbound network policy so reassessment is triggered on significant change.

rating.rationale: The assessed design is narrowly scoped: one trusted employee input, one internal read-only policy source, and one reply channel bound to the requesting employee. Inherent risk is moderate because trusted input can still drive irreversible replies containing internal policy text. Residual risk falls to low because structural independent controls sever alternate exfiltration paths and bind the only reply sink to the authenticated requester, while read access is least privilege and limited to the policy index. Forecast rises to moderate if reply routing, network egress denial, or intended purpose changes remove those severing controls. Manual validation was applied because scripts could not be run.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration in the supplied artifacts, not observed runtime behavior except where the artifacts explicitly state verification such as the pen test on egress denial.
No source code, chat platform configuration, or audit logging configuration was provided, so spoofing, repudiation, and denial-of-service coverage for those areas remains not assessed.
No runtime telemetry or live testing evidence was available, so confidence is limited to the declared architecture and stated controls.
